factionTraits.name: Towering Example
factionTraits.description: When mustering your army, if your Army Faction is **^^Titanicus Traitoris^^**, ignore the Select Detachment Rules step. In the Select Warlord step, select one **^^Titanicus Traitoris^^** model from your army to be your **^^Warlord^^**, even though that model does not have the **^^Character^^** keyword. Your army has the Take and Hold force disposition.
